description: One art-direction move when the person wants «more …» or «less …», by Paletoo’s own rules: more_premium (a serif headline, spaced small capitals, quieter colour); less_text (the least needed lines hidden — never the headline, brand, button or a fact the person gave; on a menu it returns a `question` instead, then call again with rows_to_hide); bigger_photo (larger or closer, or a fitting photo added); more_playful (a round face, the accent on small words, playful shapes); bolder (a heavier headline and one loud accent); more_creative (the next style recipe the design has not worn). Then polished (fits, aligned, readable); live if open, else a new version. Example: { design, direction: «more_premium» }.

artboard.description: one artboard’s id (from get_design); none: every artboard

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

direction.description: what the person asked for: more_premium, less_text, bigger_photo, more_playful, bolder, more_creative

rows_to_hide.description: less_text on a menu or a price list: how many rows (from the end) the person agreed may be hidden — only after they said so (the tool asks first)

name: refine_design
title: Refine a design
